question: Does raising the loss weight of only li, li_scored, kappa, r_axis and volume (0.05 -> 0.2) keep D4's head gains without its triangularity/boundary losses, out of fold?
selection_disclosure: the label set was chosen from D4's fold-0 per-scalar deltas (ledger 2.14); fold 0 is therefore NOT used here — evaluation is on fold 1 (80 held shots, never used to choose anything in D4/D4b).
design: fold 1 of the K-fold OOF framework; S16 refit on Kaggle CUDA with original seeds; package fec_adapter at 244c4cd (FitSettings.label_weights); amendments 1/2 as in D4; bank readout with fold 1 excluded; v25 finisher (kfold_build) as V0.
metric: pooled S every 2nd frame, paired shot bootstrap 20000 seed 930 (as R8/D4).
decision_rule: extend to folds 0,2,3,4 (and then build a public candidate) only if fold-1 dS >= +2e-5 and P >= 0.8; otherwise reject. Adoption needs pooled 5-fold dS >= +2e-5, P >= 0.9.
